summary: Iteration 66 - SmartMap Feature Testing Complete. Backend API tests: 13/13 passed. integration_issues.issue: Geocoding takes 30-60+ seconds for full travel plans with many activities. Loading state shows correctly but may appear stuck to users.
integration_issues.note: This is expected behavior due to rate-limiting on Photon API (0.5s stagger per location). Backend API works correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 66 verified SmartMap premium feature. Key findings: (1) Backend endpoints POST /api/ai/geocode-plan, /api/ai/optimize-route, /api/ai/improve-location all require auth (401) and ambassador level (403 for sonhador). (2) Geocoding uses Photon API with Nominatim fallback and MongoDB cache. (3) Rate limiting (0.5s stagger per location) causes slow loading for large plans (30-60+ seconds). (4) Frontend SmartMap component renders inside TravelPlanner after plan generation, wrapped in PremiumGate with label 'Desbloqueia o mapa interativo'. (5) SmartMap has day filters (Todos, Dia 1, Dia 2), 'Otimizar percurso' button, sidebar with locations list, and Leaflet map with CartoDB tiles. (6) Custom peach markers with day numbers. (7) AI Assistant regression test passed. Note: Full UI testing requires generating a travel plan first (takes ~30 seconds) then waiting for geocoding (additional 30-60 seconds for full plans).
